question: Who is qualified in relation to the tradition that consists of the great scriptures?
premises: The qualified person delights in devotion to the guru.
She or that tradition is described as consisting of the great scriptures.
inference: One who delights in devotion to the guru is connected to that which consists of the great scriptures.
uncertainties: The referent of sā (goddess, tradition, or path) is context-dependent.
plain_english: Indeed, whoever delights in devotion to the guru—she is composed of the great scriptures.
